policy: DEMONSTRATION SET. The discretionary half of this document excludes NOBODY: `entries` is empty, so no human has decided that any address is not a beneficial holder. The mechanical half applies one predicate rule, `off_curve_owner`, which removes token accounts whose owner is not a valid ed25519 point and therefore cannot be signed for by any keypair. That is not a policy choice about who deserves the money; it is the observation that an address with no possible claimant is not a claimant, and that paying one strands the funds rather than distributing them. The rule's known errors are enumerated in src/predicate.mjs and are not hypothetical: it also removes multisig vaults and smart-contract wallets, which CAN claim by CPI, and it does not remove on-curve burn sinks, which cannot. No override is in force here. Escapement's published specification (/spec section 4.5) records four cases as NOT DECIDED: the pump.fun bonding curve, the post-graduation AMM pool whose LP tokens are burned, exchange omnibus accounts, and lending-protocol collateral. All four remain listed as undecided below, because the predicate does not answer any of them as policy questions — it only removes addresses that could not claim under any answer. Exchange omnibus accounts are on-curve and are therefore PAID by this run, which is the arguable outcome the open case is about. The mint named here is an unaffiliated third-party pump.fun token chosen because it was active in the indexed slot window. No token of ours exists.
